title: Mattie Williamson wears her hair in a bun
items: The Glessners' cook had a man's short haircut under a modelled knot. She now wears a real woman's hairstyle: drawn back smooth from the face to a round bun at the back of the head.
Both women in town (Mattie in 1904, Mary Flynn in 1835) now have upper eyelashes, finer eyebrows, a narrower, straighter nose and higher cheekbones.
